install:
if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo dockerd >/tmp/dockerd-install.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 60); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done; sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null || true; fi
docker compose -f docker-compose-light.yml build
start:
if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo dockerd >/tmp/dockerd.log 2>&1 & for i in $(seq 1 60); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done; sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null || true; fi
docker compose -f docker-compose-light.yml up -d
for i in $(seq 1 90); do curl -sf http://localhost:9001/health && exit 0; sleep 5; done
echo 'Superset health check failed on :9001' >&2
exit 1
